usage: probe [<flags>]

kingpin probe


Flags:
      --[no-]help     Show context-sensitive help (also try --help-long and
                      --help-man).
  -f, --[no-]force    skip confirmation prompts
  -n, --limit=LIMIT   maximum number of results to return, a deliberately long
                      description so kingpin wraps it
      --[no-]dry-run  print what would change
  -o, --output=FILE   write output here
      --[no-]color    colorize
